records.context: Tracking settings and auxiliary pages on Mask Generation.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask#0
records.source: Tracking settings and auxiliary pages on Mask Generation.
records.translation: Mask Generation의 추적 설정과 보조 페이지.

records.context: The existing Time control reveals the time-axis settings, mounted tracking categories and tracking preview. Visibility does not change the ``timelapse`` workflow setting; its checkbox remains on the form and settings files retain their processing choices. The legacy Timelapse route opens Time and explicitly enables tracking.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask#1
records.source: The existing Time control reveals the time-axis settings, mounted tracking categories and tracking preview. Visibility does not change the ``timelapse`` pipeline setting; its checkbox remains on the form and settings files retain their processing choices. The legacy Timelapse route opens Time and explicitly enables tracking.
records.translation: 기존 Time 컨트롤은 시간축 설정, 추가된 추적 범주와 추적 미리보기를 표시합니다. 표시 여부는 워크플로의 ``timelapse`` 설정을 변경하지 않습니다. 해당 체크박스는 폼에 그대로 남고 설정 파일은 처리 옵션을 유지합니다. 기존 Timelapse 경로는 Time을 열고 추적을 명시적으로 활성화합니다.

records.context: OPS and Spatial Mask Generation retain their separate page switches and run entry points. Motility analysis remains under Measure.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask#2
records.source: OPS and Spatial Mask Generation retain their separate page switches and run entry points. Motility analysis remains under Measure.
records.translation: OPS와 Spatial Mask Generation은 각각의 페이지 전환 스위치와 실행 진입점을 유지합니다. 운동성 분석은 Measure에 그대로 있습니다.

records.context: Mount tracking controls under the existing Time visibility switch.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.install_folds#0
records.source: Mount tracking controls under the existing Time visibility switch.
records.translation: 기존 Time 표시 스위치 아래에 추적 컨트롤을 추가합니다.

records.context: Also install the example-plate and organize buttons. Installation is idempotent; no additional masthead strip is created.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.install_folds#1
records.source: Also install the example-plate and organize buttons. Installation is idempotent; no additional masthead strip is created.
records.translation: 예제 플레이트 버튼과 정리 버튼도 설치합니다. 설치를 반복해도 결과는 같으며 추가 머리글 표시줄을 만들지 않습니다.

records.context: ``None``; retained for callers of the former strip installer.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.install_folds#3
records.source: ``None``; retained for callers of the former strip installer.
records.translation: ``None``. 이전 머리글 표시줄 설치 함수를 호출하는 코드와의 호환성을 위해 유지됩니다.

records.context: Reveal imported time settings without changing processing flags.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.sync_folds#0
records.source: Reveal imported time settings without changing processing flags.
records.translation: 처리 플래그를 변경하지 않고 가져온 시간 설정을 표시합니다.

records.context: Applied settings; absent time flags preserve visibility.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.sync_folds#2
records.source: Applied settings; absent time flags preserve visibility.
records.translation: 적용된 설정. 시간 플래그가 없으면 표시 여부를 유지합니다.

records.context: Tracking fold key when imported flags reveal Time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.sync_folds#3
records.source: Tracking fold key when imported flags reveal Time.
records.translation: 가져온 플래그가 Time을 표시할 때의 추적 접이식 영역 키.
